page.overview:
Who is Myron Beech?

Myron Beech was a Human male ranger who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.

By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Myron Beech was organizing hiking trails in the Thaos Mountains. one of his hiking group that included the man named Ilyamo disappeared in the mountains. Beech was interrogated by a spacer working for Commander Talte of the Corellian Security Force.

Myron Beech appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Myron Beech was added to the game with the release of the "Publish 28," on April 26, 2006.
